paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.24% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+0.36%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-3.89%). Brent crude changed -3.87% to 92.13. Gold changed -0.59% to 3,863.3. Bitcoin changed -1.31% to 64,447.1211. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.121%, a relative move of -0.64%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-6.84%) and Vale (-6.77%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Diamondback strikes $5bn deal to expand drilling in oil-rich Permian Basin (FT World). Acquisition is latest in the heartland of the US shale boom amid volatile energy prices caused by Iran war Deals and capital markets: CVC plans to back out of Italian deal with Advent, triggering potential legal clash (FT Markets). Move to renege on agreement to buy food group Irca leads to dispute between two leading buyout firms Central banks and macro: Polish central bank freezes top court payments in escalating row with Tusk (FT World). Government accuses opposition-led NBP of playing politics in stand-off over constitutional judges Central banks and macro: Weak growth casts further doubt on Bank of Japan’s December rate rise (FT World). Real GDP contracted on a quarterly annualised basis between the second and third quarters Geopolitics and trade: Russia’s richest woman hit by EU sanctions (FT World). Founder of country’s largest online retailer Wildberries targeted in latest round of EU sanctions over war in Ukraine
